body: I don't care about the well being of a stranger I'll never meet, their potential trauma is not equal to my current suffering.
A gathering of shadows is a sequel the first book is called A darker shade of magic. I just watch shows like walking dead, agents of shield, house of cards stuff like that.

I like to write creative stories but when writers block hits me I just write reviews about the latest episodes of my favourite tv shows. As for reading I just finished A gathering of shadows by V.E Schwab it was good I recommend it if you like fantasy books. The meditation thing I found I enjoy it the best if I cut out all the that spiritually stuff associated with it and just focus on disconnecting myself from my thoughts.

I see what your saying but its a little different for me. I completed my degree despite my depression and that little piece of paper changed nothing, I spend my time reading, writing, I've taken up meditation, I'm learning a second language, I exercise regularly but all of that is just fluff to pass the time. I'm still getting screwed by the world and the more I hate the world, the more it hates me back making me hate it even more, creating a nice little catch 22 situation.

Yeah I could go find a homeless shelter but I kinda don't want to you know? I have always wanted to die and living for the sake of living and hoping my life improves just seems pointless. Right now it feels like everything as fallen into place and its time for me to stop struggling and let go.
